reviews.text: Can't find anyway to transfer to phone. I have a Galaxy watch 4, and it barely syncs to phone and when it does it doesn't even preserve the date, it sets the date of the recording the same as the sync date. When I tried to use a file explorer to extract the recordings manually, the files weren't accessible. Now I have recordings and no way to sync and preserve dates.
reviews.reply: Hi Hilal, some quick feedback: a) Please ensure your watch and phone are connected to the same wifi, b) last modified date is unfortunately not able to be set on Android, c) You can also use "Copy to the music folder" to make them accessible. We have limited space here so please contact us via Help - Contact Us in the app. Thank you.

reviews.text: Apparently doesn't work without unlimited access to the microphone. I don't allow that because it's not secure. I tried "ask every time" but it wouldn't work that way.
reviews.reply: Hi Bobby, it really should. I don't have every device, but "Ask every time" works on my test devices. If you mean it doesn't ask every single time you tap on the mic button, that's OS behavior, not something we control; it's usually a time limit. Could you please contact us via Help - Contact Us in the app so we can review further? Thank you.

reviews.text: No transcribing features, now in the AI era. 🧐 Uninstalled.
Horrible. I've had this app for years. I've recorded 18 songs that I have written. then one day I logged on and everything was just gone. don't trust this app.
reviews.reply: Hi Daniel, very sorry to hear about this. This is most likely the OS revoking storage permission. Your files should still be visible in the Files app. To see them again in the app, please re-grant permission from Settings - Files in the app, or contact us via Help - Contact Us in the app, and we will help with priority. Thank you.

reviews.text: Ive had this app for several years. I play guitar and use it to capture riffs and music ideas. I had a lot of stuff recorded. I just open the app to record something and everything that was on it for years is suddenly gone. I did nothing to delete any of the recordings. Just one day everything is gone. Thanks garbage trash app. Un(F'n)believable!
reviews.reply: Hi, very sorry to hear about this. The app doesn’t have ownership over your recordings so this is most likely an OS permission issue and your recordings are still there, and should be visible via Files. Please re-grant permissions from the app settings or contact us via Help / Contact Us in the app and we’ll help you out with priority. Thank you.
